description: An agent-first sidebar for fleets of agent threads. Pinned, Specs and Unread sections reorder by drag; Unread lists only threads with something new. Specs sort by what needs you, with a picker; finished and idle specs fold into Quiet, and active tickets breathe. Cards show the issue or pull request link, children, and model and effort; the footer counts running threads and opens a steady hover card; drag pins and reorders; and wizbar CLI commands with JSON cover the sidebar's actions except the sort picker and section order. Derived from T3 Sidebar.
